sentences.translation: but it's not just about getting over it.
i smiled at the sensei too.
the sensei will be called on.
let's say goodbye to the sensei.
everyone in the class will come along.
sensei also said, i've done my best.
the next one is the rice for the shirugo.
but you can't do it yet.
i've been eating it all the time.
what do you mean by that?
kyusoku's aunt also smiled, "Welcome to me."
i'll be shy with a slap on my back.
what do you mean by all of your class?
today's day was a good day.
i'm sure you can say that.
